description: This file contains classes and functions for managing and running parallel benchmark jobs with fault tolerance, core pinning, and progress reporting.

classes.name: WorkerFailed
classes.description: Custom exception indicating a worker failure detected in the main process.

classes.name: CorePool
classes.description: Helper class to allocate and reserve CPU core ranges for tasks, supporting core pinning.

classes.name: Runner
classes.description: Main class to manage and execute a set of work items in parallel, handling core reservations, progress, and fault tolerance.

methods.name: reserve
methods.description: Reserves a contiguous range of CPU cores for a task, returning a taskset string or None.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Runner with work items, optional core pool, and cadence.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the work items, managing progress, handling exceptions, and returning results.

methods.name: _run
methods.description: Internal method that performs the main execution loop for the work items.

methods.name: _update_active_jobs
methods.description: Checks and updates the status of active jobs, handling finished jobs and failures.

methods.name: _enqueue_new_jobs
methods.description: Attempts to reserve cores and enqueue new work items for execution.

methods.name: _print_progress
methods.description: Displays progress, elapsed time, and ETA.

methods.name: _force_shutdown
methods.description: Attempts to gracefully or forcibly terminate active jobs during shutdown.

methods.name: _canary_import
methods.description: Verifies that 'torch' can be imported in subprocesses before starting jobs.
